scope: Real module and engine; synthetic clips labelled as fixtures, no new art

checks.name: Exact sequence keys cover both orientations without inheriting attack or death states
An authored round clip respects its explicit tick rather than the stale actor attack tick
Round and final ticks can be rewound without presentation state leaking into gameplay
Malformation and unknown slots never manufacture a valid presentation or conclusion
A drawn final outro is never substituted for a match or round loss
Preparation data carries no command, life, mutation or source of campaign rewards
A complete first-to-two CPU match produces reversible round results and one final victor
